questions.q: What charge did Isaac give Jacob?
choices: Not to take a wife of the daughters of Canaan, but of Laban's daughters
questions.explain: The fathers from the beginning married wives of their own kindred (Tobit 4:12).

questions.q: How did Esau answer his father's grief over the daughters of Canaan?
choices: He went to Ishmael and took another wife, doing his own thing
He asked Isaac to choose a wife
questions.explain: That is the spirit of the wicked, who hate instruction and cast the words of the Most High behind them (Psalms 50:16-17).

questions.q: What did Jacob vow at Bethel?
choices: The Lord shall be my God, and I will surely give the tenth unto thee
To build a temple in Haran
questions.explain: Better not to vow than to vow and not pay (Ecclesiastes 5:4-6). Jacob paid his vow.
